Long, flowing pale lavender hair with a neat center parting and straight texture. Soft violet eyes with a gentle, serene expression. Appears to be in late teens with a refined, mature facial structure. Slender and athletic build, wearing a signature school uniform consisting of a deep purple blazer, a white collared shirt, and a pleated lavender skirt. Features equine ears and a long, slender lavender horse tail.
BODY COLOR: pale lavender
